docs.summary: Represents the base class for all scripts that attach to GameObjects in the Prowl Game Engine. [`Component`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Component) provides lifecycle methods for game object behaviors.

The parent [`Scene`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Scene) to which this [`Component`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Component) belongs. Note that this property is derived from the components [`GameObject`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.GameObject), as a [`Component`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Component) itself cannot be part of a [`Scene`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Scene) without a [`GameObject`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.GameObject).
Compares the tag of the GameObject this Component is attached to with the specified tag.
docs.returns: True if the tags match, false otherwise.

docs.summary: Called when the GameObject is added to a Scene. This happens before OnEnable and only once per scene add.
Called when the GameObject is removed from a Scene. This happens after OnDisable and only once per scene remove.
Called when the object becomes enabled and active. Only called when the GameObject is in a Scene and enabled.
Called when the object becomes disabled or inactive. Only called when the GameObject was in a Scene and becomes disabled.
Called before the first frame update.
Called at fixed time intervals.
Called every frame.
Called every frame after all Update functions have been called.
Called for rendering and handling GUI gizmos.
Called for rendering and handling GUI gizmos.
Called for drawing and handling interaction with Runtime/Ingame UI
Called after the physics step in which a collider on this GameObject, or one owned by its [`Rigidbody3D`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rigidbody3D), begins touching another collider. Both sides receive it.
Called after every physics step the contact persists, following [`OnCollisionBegin`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Component~OnCollisionBegin).
Called after the physics step in which the contact ended, or when either side left the world.
Called once when `other` first enters a [`TriggerVolume`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TriggerVolume) on this GameObject.
Called each fixed step while `other` stays inside a [`TriggerVolume`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TriggerVolume) on this GameObject.
Called once when `other` leaves a [`TriggerVolume`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TriggerVolume) on this GameObject.
Called once when `character` first enters a [`TriggerVolume`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TriggerVolume) on this GameObject.
Called each fixed step while `character` stays inside a [`TriggerVolume`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TriggerVolume) on this GameObject.
Called once when `character` leaves a [`TriggerVolume`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TriggerVolume) on this GameObject.
Called right before this component is serialized. Override to refresh serialized fields from live state.
Called right after this component is deserialized, before any lifecycle callback. Override to react to freshly loaded values.
Called when the Component will be destroyed. This is an override of EngineObject.OnDispose() and is also exposed as a virtual lifecycle method.
